description: This file implements a command for scanning models in the openclaw project, including functions for sorting, prompting, and updating model configurations, as well as the main 'modelsScanCommand' function handling user interaction and model scanning logic.

methods.name: multiselect
methods.description: A wrapper around clackMultiselect that styles options with prompts and hints.

methods.name: guardPromptCancel
methods.description: Checks if a prompt result is a cancel signal; if so, cancels the operation and exits.

methods.name: sortScanResults
methods.description: Sorts model scan results prioritizing image status, latency, and metadata.

methods.name: sortImageResults
methods.description: Sorts model scan results prioritizing image latency and metadata.

methods.name: compareScanMetadata
methods.description: Compares two scan results based on context length, inferred parameters, and model reference.

methods.name: buildScanHint
methods.description: Constructs a descriptive hint string for a scan result.

methods.name: printScanSummary
methods.description: Logs a summary of scan results including counts of successful tool and image tests.

methods.name: printScanTable
methods.description: Outputs a formatted table of scan results.

methods.name: modelsScanCommand
methods.description: Main function to perform model scanning, user prompting, and configuration updates based on scan results.
